title: C# LINQ Basics
description: LINQ (Language Integrated Query) is a set of technologies that allows you to query data from different sources (arrays, collections, etc.).
example:
int[] scores = { 90, 71, 82, 93, 75, 82 };
var query = from s in scores where s > 80 select s;

challenges.title: Numbers Query
challenges.exercise: Create int[] nr = {1, 5, 8}. Use LINQ to select numbers > 4. Print the count.

challenges.title: LINQ Methods
challenges.exercise: Use .Where(n => n > 4) on {1, 5, 8} and print the sum.

challenges.title: Ordering
challenges.exercise: Order the list {3, 1, 2} using .OrderBy(n => n) and print the first element.

challenges.title: Any Method
challenges.exercise: Check if {1, 2} contains any number > 1 using .Any(). Print result.

challenges.title: Average
challenges.exercise: Calculate the average of {10, 20, 30} using LINQ and print it.
